name: Fall Pearl Couscous Salad
desc: Pearl couscous with roasted butternut squash, massaged kale, cranberries, red onion and pecans in a maple-cider dressing.

source.title: Fall Pearl Couscous Salad
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 small butternut squash (about 2 lb), peeled and diced
2 cups lacinato kale leaves, stems removed and chopped (or green kale)
Salt and black pepper, for roasting
1/2 cup crumbled feta or 2 cups shredded cooked chicken (optional)
ingredients.item: crumbled feta or shredded cooked chicken

steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss the squash with 1 tbsp olive oil and season generously with salt and pepper. Spread on the sheet and roast 25 to 30 min, until tender. Let cool.

While the squash roasts, bring the water to a boil in a small saucepan. Add the couscous, cover, reduce the heat to low and simmer 10 to 12 min, until tender and the water is absorbed. Let cool completely.
Toast the pecans in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring, 3 to 5 min, until fragrant. Let cool and roughly chop.
Whisk the dressing ingredients together in a measuring cup or jar.
Put the kale in a large serving bowl with a small splash of the dressing and rub the leaves between your hands for about 5 min, until they soften, shrink and turn bright green.
Add the cooled squash, couscous, cranberries and red onion, pour over as much dressing as you like and toss. Taste and adjust salt and pepper.
Serve right away or chill 30 min to 1 hr. Top each portion with the toasted pecans, plus feta or chicken if using.
tips: Good for meal-prep lunches. Keep the pecans separate so they stay crunchy.
